citations.excerpt: All values are integer minor units in a single currency. Compute ledger net as the signed sum of capture, fee and refund postings. Preserve the processor refund reference, confirmation event, ledger snapshot cutoff and exact difference. Escalate the posting exception for a human reconciliation review. The investigator must not create a refund, repair a ledger or transfer money.
